steps.content: The luxury black sedan glides smoothly along the road. Inside, a middle-aged man sips his iced wine while gazing at the city lights coming alive outside his window. Their reflection on the glass transforms into a dazzling constellation.
His phone rings, and the middle-aged man answers it, letting a deliberate silence hang before the caller speaks.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: Mr. Worthington, I've captured the target as per your instructions.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: As I suspected, she had been following me. I've handed her over to your men and sent all relevant information to you.
Just as he finishes speaking, a notification ping sounds in the car. Worthington opens his backup device to find a digital file from his trusted operative.

Pine's personal records have been erased, with her file marked as "dead." The attached photo shows her motionless body lying in an alley corner, covered in mud. Her voice recorder lies shattered on the ground beside her.
Worthington studies the photo for a while before deleting it with satisfaction.

steps.speaker: Worthington
steps.content: Well done. Rest assured, I'll make sure that you receive your share as promised.

steps.speaker: Worthington
steps.content: I'll personally introduce you at tonight's charity gala in Eastside. Make sure to highlight all your recent philanthropic work in town—it never hurts to get familiar with Eastside's elite circles, Future Councilor of Shedde.
Without waiting for Hale's response, Worthington ends the call, tosses the phone aside, and lets out a contemptuous sneer.

steps.speaker: Worthington
steps.content: Ideals and principles? Please. People only stick to their convictions because they haven't been offered the right price yet.
The sedan comes to a smooth stop in front of a hotel. The middle-aged man adjusts his expensive suit and practices his smile before stepping out with the chauffeur's assistance.
In an instant, a surge of camera flashes erupts around him, illuminating what would prove to be a momentous evening.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: This year, philanthropy stands as one of Eastside's key development initiatives. Ladies and gentlemen, your dedication to charitable causes deserves our highest commendation and sets an example for us all.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: And now, please welcome our distinguished representative from Shedde Town, Mr. Worthington, to deliver his address!
The banquet hall erupts in thunderous applause. Amid waves of adulation and flattery, Worthington makes his way to the stage with measured steps, takes the microphone, and clears his throat.

steps.speaker: Worthington
steps.content: While I stand here as a representative, the truth is that everyone present has contributed far more to our cause and wields greater influence than I do. My presence on this stage is purely thanks to your gracious humility in offering me this opportunity to speak.

steps.speaker: She smothers her agony, forces back the encroaching contamination with a sweeping slash, and plants herself as the final barrier between you and the horde.
steps.content: As many of you may have heard, our town recently experienced a tragic incident. The pharmaceutical factory suffered an explosion due to aging equipment—a devastating accident that weighs heavily on my heart to this day, particularly for those families who lost their loved ones.

steps.speaker: Worthington
steps.content: What you may not know is that in the wake of this incident, amid the overwhelming public outcry, Mr. Hale—my subordinate and Shedde's administrative officer—stepped forward without hesitation. He shared my burden, working tirelessly alongside me in the aftermath to minimize the impact and contribute significantly to the factory's reconstruction efforts.

steps.speaker: Worthington
steps.content: As philanthropy is the theme of tonight's gathering, and since this promising young man has dedicated his career to charitable works, I'd like to invite him to say a few words. I hope you'll all give him your warmest encouragement—after all, making new connections can only benefit us all!
At this point, naturally, no one would object. The host, promptly following the new program, proceeds to invite this supposedly accomplished young man to the stage.
Amid polite applause and curious whispers, Hale makes his way to the stage, takes the microphone, and positions himself at the center.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: I must thank Mr. Worthington for providing me with countless opportunities that have led me to where I stand today, sharing my accomplishments with you all. Regarding the factory incident, as Mr. Worthington mentioned, we've worked tirelessly to resolve numerous issues.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: Such as initiating the factory's reconstruction, consoling the bereaved families, distributing compensation payments, processing insurance claims for injured workers, and securing new employment opportunities for those who lost their jobs...

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: However, I believe that Mr. Worthington is the sole reason for all these issues to be addressed and resolved.
Hale's eyes meet Worthington's, who stands nearby nodding with approval and encouragement.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: Ladies and gentlemen, do you know why I say Mr. Worthington is the sole reason?
Hale pauses for a moment, a smile playing on his lips as his gaze sweeps across every person in the banquet hall.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: That's because he is the origin of this incident—the mastermind behind this tragedy!
The banquet hall falls into a stunned silence.
After a moment, murmurs of unrest ripple through the crowd. Seeing this, Worthington rushes forward and snatches the microphone from Hale's hand.

steps.speaker: Worthington
steps.content: Please, everyone, let me explain!

steps.speaker: Worthington
steps.content: This young man got a bit too excited about his introduction today and had one too many drinks! He's just making silly jokes! Someone, please help escort him out so he can get some rest!
Several bodyguards catch their employer's signal and immediately begin advancing along the edges of the banquet hall.
He's not joking! We have proof!
Suddenly, a woman's firm voice rings out from the corner of the hall.
All eyes turn towards the source of the sound—Pine, the woman believed to have been "taken care of," now standing unscathed. You stand behind her, silently watching as events are about to unfold.

Pine gracefully evades the circle of bodyguards and leaps onto the stage, positioning herself right in front of Worthington. A wave of gasps and whispers ripples through the crowd below. At the sight of Pine, Worthington's face turns pale, though he forces himself to maintain a smile.

steps.speaker: Worthington
steps.content: Miss, please step down from the stage. If you have any complaints or suspicions about me, you can file them through proper channels instead of causing repeated disruptions like this.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Causing disruptions? Are you so eager to get rid of me because I'm being disruptive, or because you have something to hide?

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: You want proper channels? Fine, let's show everyone exactly how your proper channels really work.
Catching Pine's signal, you quickly power up her laptop and the hall's projector. A moment later, a scanned document appears on the screen.
Pine clears her throat, pulls out a microphone from her pocket, and turns the volume up to maximum.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Ladies and gentlemen, take a look at this document provided by the manager of Shedde's pharmaceutical factory. It clearly details the financial transactions between him and Worthington—each transfer worth millions of DisCoins!
A collective gasp echoes through the crowd, but Pine only responds with a knowing smirk.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: We're not done yet. I've also got a video for you.
The screen switches to surveillance footage, clearly showing Worthington and the pharmaceutical factory's manager in conversation within a secret laboratory:

steps.speaker: Factory Manager
steps.content: ...Those researchers are threatening to expose everything we've done. If we don't give them an answer, they're really going to the authorities!

steps.speaker: Worthington
steps.content: Authorities? Out of the question. I won't allow it. And neither will you. An accident would be better, wouldn't it? It can help us eliminate the liability completely, and I'll even gain some sympathy and goodwill...

steps.speaker: Worthington
steps.content: This is fabricated! Illegal methods! This is—
Worthington's face turns ghostly pale as he desperately clutches the microphone to defend himself, only to be cut off by Pine's cold, mocking laugh.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Fabricated, you say? Well, then how would you explain this internal laboratory report?

The screen lights up again, this time displaying a detailed experimental log documenting research into illegal drugs involving Mania. At the bottom of the document, there's a clear signature from the facility manager, along with Worthington's written instruction: "Provide full support regardless of cost."

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: There's a secret laboratory inside Shedde's pharmaceutical factory, dedicated to developing illegal drugs for massive profits. And you, Town Councilor of Shedde, not only have you been taking your cut of the profits for years, but you've also abused your authority to protect these criminals.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: In recent years, the laboratory wasn't content with just illegal drugs anymore—they ventured into Mania research. But the researchers, fearing for their lives, demanded to leave the project.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: They banded together to pressure you and the factory manager, threatening to expose all evidence of illegal research over the years if you didn't let them walk away, ready to bring everyone down with them if necessary.
Pine advances towards Worthington, closing in relentlessly without giving an inch.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: The factory explosion was no accident at all—it was a tragedy orchestrated by you and the manager!

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Covering up illegal research, silencing the researchers, and still managing to win public sympathy while currying favor with Eastside's elite—what a flawless plan, wasn't it?
The crowd erupts into chaos as countless phones point toward the stage, camera flashes lighting up the scene in waves. Worthington tries to speak, but his voice trembles with panic.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Your so-called "dedication to the factory's reconstruction" was nothing but stepping stones made from innocent blood!
Pine's voice grows more piercing as she jabs an accusing finger right in Worthington's face.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: You thought your power would shield you, but today, I'll show your true colors to all of Eastside—no, to the whole world!

steps.speaker: Worthington
steps.content: You're crazy... You're crazy! Guards! Where are my bodyguards?! Get her out of here!
As Worthington's voice breaks into desperate howls, his bodyguards attempt to approach the podium, only to be intercepted by Public Security Bureau agents who have been lying in wait.
The sound of synchronized footsteps echoes from the banquet hall entrance as a sheriff marches in with his team, fixing Worthington with a cold stare.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Mr. Worthington, you are suspected of multiple charges, including murder and concealment of illegal activities. Please cooperate with our investigation.
Worthington completely loses his composure and tries to flee through the crowd, only to be immediately arrested. Still, he struggles wildly, his face flushed red as he screams in a hoarse voice:

steps.speaker: Worthington
steps.content: Everything I did was for Shedde! The illegal drug research at the factory—it was all to secure more funding and support, to save our collapsing economy! Without the factory, what would be left of this town?!

steps.speaker: Worthington
steps.content: The explosion... it all boils down to the researchers' incompetence! Yes, I may have been careless, failing to supervise them strictly, but everything is to ensure the people of Shedde have food on their tables, jobs to work, and a future to look forward to!

steps.speaker: Worthington
steps.content: You can't arrest me! Do you have any idea how much I've sacrificed for Shedde over the years?! No one will ever love this place and its people as much as I do!

Yet in the face of irrefutable evidence laid bare before everyone, all his elaborate excuses and justifications ring hollow. The only response to Worthington's desperate explanations comes in the form of harsh camera flashes and contemptuous stares.

steps.speaker: Worthington
steps.content: And you... you...
As the security officers escort him past you and Pine, Worthington lunges forward with bloodshot eyes and grabs Pine by the collar.

steps.speaker: Worthington
steps.content: You'll regret this, Pine! You have no idea what you're getting yourself into! This won't make you a hero—you'll get yourself destroyed! Mark my words, you'll go down just like me!

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: ...I know I'm doomed sooner or later, and this world is too, Councilor.
Pine takes an apathetic step back. She swats away Worthington's grip on her collar as if brushing off a speck of dust.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: But I refuse to let someone like you outlive me.
This afternoon, in an alley in Shedde.
...So let me get this straight—you reported yourself under Worthington's orders, with the purpose of drawing Pine out and delivering her to him.
And you agreed to this because he promised to make you the next Town Councilor of Shedde once he advances his own position?
Upon Hale's confirmation, Pine furrows her brow.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: I still don't get it. You sent me the email, yet you also led us to this alley—which means you did accept his terms and the plan has been in motion.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: If that's the case, why did you suddenly turn against him and tell us everything?
Hale turns his gaze to Pine.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: Because of you.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Me?
You and Pine exchange a puzzled look.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: Actually, I've been aware of your presence since you first showed up outside our office building early this morning. Installing cameras, planting bugs, infiltrating for information, going through my files—I knew about all of it.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: To be honest, I've been quite curious about you. I've heard completely different opinions about the Hedgehog's Eye—some say you're nothing but troublemakers, while others call you legendary. I was never sure which view was the right one.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: Watching you today has really opened my eyes to the fact that you're not quite what most people think. Your investigation is thorough and meticulous—you're genuinely seeking the truth, not just chasing sensational headlines.
Hale looks up at Pine, his expression growing grave.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: This has made me see you in a new light, and it reminds me of who I used to be—full of ideals when I first entered this circle, aspiring to be a beacon of light that dispels darkness, instills hope in all, and guides towards a brighter future.
Hale's voice drops to barely above a whisper, as if lost in painful memories.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: But the reality is, my work has made enemies of many superiors, Worthington included. Yes, I've known for a long time that Worthington is nothing but a complete hypocrite. He's been suppressing me, retaliating against me, tearing down everything I've worked for...

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Did you try to fight back?

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: How could I fight back? File reports? Lodge complaints? Stage protests? I tried everything imaginable countless times, but in the end, he shut down my every single attempt.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: During that time, I was nearly driven to the edge of sanity. I started to doubt whether my principles would ever work, whether... the only way to bring him down and win my place was to fight in the same underhanded way as he did.
Pine folds her arms across her chest, her brows furrowed as she speaks.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: And then he just happened to extend an olive branch to you?

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: That's right. Just a few days ago, he came to me with an offer—if I helped him catch you, he'd let bygones be bygones and promote me.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: I had my doubts about his true intentions... but I also felt that this was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity—a chance to completely turn my situation around.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: I thought that instead of fighting him head-on, I could pretend to accept his offer. If I could truly become his confidant, I might find the smoking gun I needed to bring him down for good.
Pine lets out a scoff, her tone remaining contemptuous.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: So you decided to play double agent?

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: Yes, that was my original plan, but then... I overheard your conversation, about your past.
Hale turns to Pine, his eyes betraying a storm of emotions.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: You remind me of what I originally stood for. In the end, I just can't bow down to the world like this. I can't let myself become someone like him. I figured I might as well hold onto my naive ideals one last time—
He pauses for a moment, his gaze growing intensely resolute.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: So, if you're willing, I'd like to work with you. I have complete faith in your abilities now. With your help, perhaps we can find a more just way to bring Worthington down.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: I might consider working together, but before that, I have a question—

Despite Hale's heartfelt confession, Pine remains unmoved. Her eyes bore into his with an unwavering intensity as she takes out her phone, pulling up the list of criminal evidence from the tip-off and thrusting it before him.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: How much of this is real? Were you involved? Don't lie to me—think carefully before you answer.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: Of course, it's not true! It's all fabricated!

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Oh? It takes quite some skill to forge evidence without leaving a single trace.
Pine raises an eyebrow, skepticism written all over her face. Her provocative demeanor finally pushes Hale over the edge.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: I'm not lying to you! I couldn't have done any of this! Worthington had all this fake evidence prepared—he just told me to forward it to you!
Pine falls silent for a moment, seemingly accepting his explanation. But she soon strokes her chin, her brow furrowing once again.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Still... feels like we're missing something here...

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: With Worthington's capabilities, he could have made this plan airtight. He wouldn't have left any chance for you to have second thoughts like this... Is he pressed for time? Is that why he's been rushing things? Why is he so desperate to get rid of me?
You purse your lips in contemplation.

If this is just about you disrupting his public speech three days ago, it seems rather far-fetched... He's left you alone all these years without sending another assassin, confident that you couldn't take him down anytime soon. There's no reason for him to rush now, unless...
A sudden realization strikes you. When your eyes meet Pine's, it's clear that you have both reached the same conclusion.
She claps her hands suddenly and continues.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Unless he thinks I've gotten my hands on some damning evidence against him in the past couple of days!
She quickly scrolls through the evidence on her phone, finally stopping at a photo of Hale at the pharmaceutical factory late at night.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: This has to be it—the factory explosion!
Hale's eyes widen in complete shock.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: So this "accident" was actually orchestrated by him?!

Now everything makes sense. If his plan succeeded, he could use you to eliminate Pine while gaining leverage to keep controlling you. If it failed, he could still use Pine to pin the explosion on you and walk away clean.
Either way, he has all angles covered with his brilliantly calculated scheme.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: So... what should we do now?
Pine breaks into a smile.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Expose him, of course. How could we pass up such a perfect opportunity?

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: But that brings us back to our original problem—we don't have any evidence.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: If we don't have evidence, then we'll find some. Tell me, according to your original plan, how were you supposed to hand me over to him?

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: Worthington gave me his trusted subordinate's contact information. This man was supposed to take care of you. He accompanies Worthington everywhere and has unrestricted access to both his office and residence.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Perfect. Worthington's trust in this person can work to our benefit. You can continue to play along and contact him to come pick me up. Once we have him under control, we'll use his phone to message Worthington, making him believe his plan has succeeded.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Let's start by squeezing some information out of this trusted associate of his. Even if he keeps his mouth shut, ${PlayerName} and I can still pay a visit to the pharmaceutical factory manager. I'm sure he must've kept some dirt on Worthington from their dealings as insurance.
Pine turns to you with a devious smile.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: These shrewd businessmen are masters at reading the wind. We simply have to intimidate him with your authority, make it clear that we're aware of everything, and hint at leniency in exchange for cooperation. He'll scramble in no time to hand over the evidence against Worthington.
Finally, she gestures at Hale.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: As for you, Worthington is taking you to that charity gala in Eastside tonight, right? Attend as planned and buy us as much time as you can until we get there.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Any questions? No? ...Then let's get moving!
Outside the hotel, you stand with Hale and Pine, watching the Public Security Bureau vehicles drive away as their sirens fade into the distance. A storm of emotions wells up inside you.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Hey, are you really going to keep doing this?

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: Are you asking me?

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Who else would I be asking? The rookie standing next to me?
Pine rolls her eyes, but her expression quickly turns grave as she addresses Hale.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: I'm dead serious. After everything you've seen—the factory accident, the evidence displayed in the banquet hall, the darkness and hypocrisy of those people—do you still want to stay?
Hale gives a slight smile, his gaze shifting between you and Pine for a moment.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: Of course. If anything, meeting you both has only strengthened my resolve to hold onto these foolish, naive aspirations of mine a little longer.
Pine's eyes darken as she parts her lips, only to restrain herself from speaking.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: I understand your concerns and what you're trying to tell me. But this whole thing has taught me that to change darkness, one must step into it—criticizing from the safety of the light alone accomplishes nothing.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: Only by truly immersing myself in it, experiencing its cruelty and suffocation firsthand as you have, can I find the opportunity to shatter it completely.
Hearing Hale's words, Pine lets out a sardonic laugh, her tone brimming with mockery.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: You make it sound so simple, but do you really understand? Once you step onto this path, there's no turning back.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: You'll only face more situations like this in the future, each more dangerous than the last. And when deeper temptations arise, holding onto your principles will only get harder... One wrong step, and there's no coming back from that abyss!

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Your end could be just as tragic as Worthington's today—tomorrow it could be you in his place. You have no idea what kind of person you might meet down the road, sharing the same end.
Yet in the face of Pine's doubts, Hale simply nods once more, his expression grave and resolute.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: I understand everything you're saying, but my mind is made up. I don't know what the future holds, but I promise to always remember your words of warning in this moment, and everything we've faced together today.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: So if one day I end up like those you despise, I ask that you bring me to justice, just as we did to Worthington today.

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: Besides, it's not all that grim. Who says every person in a position of power has to be beyond redemption? Don't we have a perfect example of a decent one right here with us?

steps.speaker: Hale
steps.content: I doubt today would have gone this smoothly without his support, don't you think?
steps.female_content: I doubt today would have gone this smoothly without her support, don't you think?

steps.content: With Hale's resolve clear as day, Pine falls silent. She stuffs her hands in her pockets and turns away, walking in the opposite direction.
On your way back, Pine walks beside you in complete silence, seemingly lost in thought.
What's on your mind? Something troubling you? Mind if your "assistant" helps you figure it out?
After a long silence, you try to break the ice with a playful comment. Pine shoots you an irritated look before retorting.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Help me? Worry about yourself instead of playing therapist. I've only scratched the surface of all the filth in Eastside, but I can tell you this much—there's serious danger ahead of you.
I know, but worrying about it now won't help. We'll cross those bridges when we come to them... For now, let's focus on what's actually bothering you. You're still worried about Hale, aren't you?
Pine lets out a sigh and shakes her head resignedly.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Whether Hale chooses to get out now or stays trapped in this mess... it shouldn't matter to me. I've never been one to meddle in other people's business. But today, something changed when he smiled at me. I just... couldn't keep quiet.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: I think I saw myself in him... my past self...

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Back then, I still had hope for this world. I believed light could exist even in the darkest places, while I stood in that light, fighting against the darkness... Just like him, I once thought that was enough to challenge everything.
Pine turns to look at you. The city blazes with neon lights, bright as day, but on this dazzling night, how many realize they're sinking into darkness, trapped in a mire of their own making?

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: People change, especially when we grow and age in this filth, eventually consumed by it. Soon enough, he won't be who he is now either.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: He might remember our words and everything that happened today, but he'll just laugh it all off someday. He'll mock how naive he once was, thinking he's finally gained the power to control everything.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: He'll end up just like them. He is their past, and they are his future.
Maybe so, but what difference does it make?
Pine stares at you, somewhat puzzled.
Even if he changes in the future, so what?
We should at least believe in who he is right now. Maybe he really can make the world a better place. Besides, in a world this vast, he's not the only one trying to make a difference.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: You...
Going to call me an amateur or rookie again? Before you disagree, maybe you should remember your own go-to phrase—"Without evidence to prove otherwise, you can't claim what I'm saying isn't true."
Pine pauses, her expression caught between amusement and resignation. She turns to gaze at the luminous night sky and murmurs.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: I never did any of this to make the world a better place.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: I just want everyone living in this world to see its truest and ugliest face. Even those who've always been overlooked deserve to know the truth.
But isn't everything you do proof of your own conviction? You keep saying everyone ends up becoming what they despise, yet you've never lost sight of who you are.
Your methods may be questionable, but from what you've told me, I can tell that repeatedly turning down massive temptation isn't something just anyone could do.
But you've done it, Pine.
Even as shadows of emptiness cloak Pine's form, the flame of her ideals has never truly died out. Light and shadow, Pine and this world—they equally exert influence on everything around.
Pine shrugs. Clearly, she still can't accept your optimism, nor what she sees as your misinterpretation of her character.
This time, though, she doesn't even bother arguing with you. After all, even a simple leave permit application is enough to show just how worlds apart your perspectives are.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Whatever. This messed up world is going to bring itself down eventually, just not today.
She shakes her head and pulls out two lollipops from her chest pocket, warm from being kept close. She pops one in her mouth and offers you the other.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: In that case, might as well have another lollipop.
